subject.title: feat(macos): open dashboard links in a sidebar browser

question: Should this macOS sidebar browser land after a maintainer refresh preserves current-main navigation behavior and the external-content boundary remains acceptable?
rationale: The PR changes a shipped default user flow and adds a native WebKit surface for external pages, while the protected maintainer label and current merge conflict make this a human merge-risk decision.

options.title: Refresh and land with proof
options.body: Resolve the current-main conflict, preserve the merged back/forward dashboard behavior, attach redacted signed-app proof, and proceed if the boundary is acceptable.

options.title: Keep default-browser behavior
options.body: Decline the default sidebar behavior and keep plain external dashboard links opening in the user's browser.

options.title: Narrow to explicit sidebar action
options.body: Keep plain clicks external and expose the sidebar only through the context menu or another explicit action.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land with proof
recommendation.body: Resolve the current-main conflict, preserve the merged back/forward dashboard behavior, attach redacted signed-app proof, and proceed if the boundary is acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the linked feature direction and has the strongest current-main history on the affected macOS dashboard path.
